messages.subject: Dispute with Vantage Freight - need your help
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Good to speak just now. As discussed, Vantage have walked away from our three-year logistics contract with eight months still to run and they're sitting on £487k of unpaid invoices. They sent us a letter on 9 May claiming they could terminate "for convenience" - which isn't in the contract as far as I can see.

Can Whitfield Carter take this on? I'll send over the agreement and the invoices. We want to move quickly.

Gordon
Gordon Sutherland
Managing Director, Sutherland Logistics Limited

messages.subject: RE: Dispute with Vantage Freight - need your help
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Gordon,

Thank you - yes, we'd be glad to act. On a first look this sounds like a strong claim: a fixed-term agreement with no termination-for-convenience right, plus a clean debt for the unpaid invoices.

I'm copying Tom Gallagher, who will be the associate on the matter. Please send the signed agreement, the three unpaid invoices and the 9 May termination letter and we'll get an engagement letter and a strategy note to you this week. Our matter reference is WC-00115.

Kind regards,
Sarah

--
